title: China-to-Uganda Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: Electrical Safety and Mains Voltage Compatibility
rows.target_requirement: Uganda commonly adopts US and IEC safety standards, including the IEC 62841 series for hand-held, transportable, and lawn-and-garden electric tools, enforced through UNBS conformity and the PVoC programme. The Uganda grid is 240 V at 50 Hz, so the tool, charger, and power supply must be rated and tested for 240 V mains, even though the 50 Hz frequency matches China. Charger and external power-supply safety is assessed together with the tool as part of the conformity package.
target_standards: IEC 62841 series (adopted as the national safety basis for electric motor-operated hand-held, transportable, and lawn-and-garden tools)
UNBS conformity assessment under the Pre-Export Verification of Conformity (PVoC) programme
240 V / 50 Hz mains rating and test condition for the Uganda market
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files commonly use the GB/T 3883 series, with CCC where applicable, validated at the China nominal mains voltage of 220/380 V at 50 Hz. The 50 Hz frequency matches Uganda, but the China test voltage differs from the Uganda 240 V mains, so voltage-dependent safety evidence may need re-verification.
china_standards: China nominal mains 220/380 V at 50 Hz
rows.gap: The main gaps are standard family and test voltage. China GB/T 3883 evidence must be mapped to the IEC 62841 series that Uganda adopts, and the 240 V Uganda mains must be reflected in the ratings and voltage-dependent tests; a report run only at 220 V may not fully represent the Uganda condition. UNBS conformity through PVoC, not the China domestic report alone, is what clears the shipment.

target.en: Mandatory: UNBS conformity through the PVoC programme for in-scope electric power tools, with IEC 62841 series as the adopted safety basis and a 240 V / 50 Hz mains rating for the Uganda market.
target.zh: 强制：适用电动工具须通过 PVoC 程序取得 UNBS 符合性，以 IEC 62841 系列为采用的安全基础，并按乌干达市场 240 V / 50 Hz 市电额定。
target.zht: 強制：適用電動工具須通過 PVoC 程序取得 UNBS 符合性，以 IEC 62841 系列為採用的安全基礎，並按烏干達市場 240 V / 50 Hz 市電額定。

cn.en: China domestic baseline commonly uses the GB/T 3883 series, with CCC where applicable, at 220/380 V mains.
cn.zh: 中国境内基线通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列，适用时配合 CCC，市电为 220/380 V。
cn.zht: 中國境內基線通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列，適用時配合 CCC，市電為 220/380 V。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Uganda-ready until the safety file is mapped to the IEC 62841 series, the 240 V mains rating and voltage-dependent tests are confirmed, and UNBS conformity is obtained through PVoC rather than relying on the China GB/T 3883 report alone.

rows.target_requirement: Uganda generally relies on adopted IEC and international EMC standards rather than a dedicated regional EMC directive. Motor-driven tools, electronic speed controllers, chargers, and power supplies should not cause excessive electromagnetic disturbance and should have adequate immunity, with EMC evidence reviewed as part of the UNBS conformity and PVoC package. For cordless tools with radio functions, EMC also interacts with UCC radio rules.
target_standards: Adopted IEC and CISPR EMC standards as referenced by UNBS
UNBS conformity assessment under the PVoC programme
Uganda Communications Commission (UCC) rules where radio functions are present
rows.china_equivalent: China compliance packages may include EMC reports alongside GB/T 3883 safety reports. Test limits, configuration, worst-case operating modes, charger inclusion, and mains-voltage condition still need review against the IEC and CISPR limits referenced for Uganda and the UNBS conformity route.
china_standards: China EMC standards and test reports where applicable
rows.gap: A frequent gap is an EMC report that tests only the bare tool but omits the charger, battery pack, or controller variants, or that was run at China 220 V rather than Uganda 240 V mains. The conformity file should reflect the exact marketed configuration and the IEC and CISPR limits referenced for the Uganda market, and route through UNBS PVoC.

target.en: Conditional: EMC is enforced through UNBS conformity and the PVoC programme using adopted IEC and CISPR standards rather than a standalone Uganda EMC directive; for radio-enabled cordless tools, UCC rules also apply.
target.zh: 有条件：EMC 通过 UNBS 符合性和 PVoC 程序、采用 IEC 和 CISPR 标准执行，而非独立的乌干达 EMC 指令；对具无线电功能的无绳工具，还适用 UCC 规则。
target.zht: 有條件：EMC 通過 UNBS 符合性和 PVoC 程序、採用 IEC 和 CISPR 標準執行，而非獨立的烏干達 EMC 指令；對具無線電功能的無繩工具，還適用 UCC 規則。

cn.en: China domestic files may include EMC evidence, but Uganda acceptance depends on scope, limits, configuration, mains condition, and UNBS conformity mapping.
cn.zh: 中国境内文件可包含 EMC 证据，但乌干达接受性取决于范围、限值、配置、市电条件及 UNBS 符合性映射。
cn.zht: 中國境內文件可包含 EMC 證據，但烏干達接受性取決於範圍、限值、配置、市電條件及 UNBS 符合性映射。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Uganda-ready until EMC evidence covers the actual marketed tool system at the Uganda 240 V mains condition, is mapped to the adopted IEC and CISPR limits, and clears UNBS conformity through PVoC; radio-enabled tools also need UCC treatment.

rows.requirement: Market Access Under UNBS PVoC, Certificate of Conformity and Q-Mark
rows.target_requirement: Electric and cordless power tools imported into Uganda fall under the UNBS Pre-Export Verification of Conformity (PVoC) programme. Regulated products generally need a Certificate of Conformity issued before shipment, verified against adopted Uganda standards (commonly US and IEC, including IEC 62841 for tool safety). Locally certified products may carry the UNBS Q-Mark. Uganda is landlocked, so goods typically transit through Mombasa or Dar es Salaam, and the PVoC certificate supports customs clearance. The PVoC requirement is a mandatory market-access control; the adopted standards are the technical basis.
target_standards: UNBS Pre-Export Verification of Conformity (PVoC) programme
UNBS Certificate of Conformity required before shipment for regulated products
UNBS Q-Mark for locally certified products
Adopted US and IEC standards, including IEC 62841 series for power-tool safety
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files commonly reference the GB/T 3883 series for hand-held, transportable, and lawn-and-garden electric tools, with CCC where applicable. GB/T 3883 evidence does not replace a UNBS Certificate of Conformity, PVoC verification, or the Q-Mark, and it must be mapped to the adopted Uganda standards.
rows.gap: A China domestic safety report is not enough for Uganda placement. The importer needs PVoC verification and a UNBS Certificate of Conformity before shipment, with the China GB/T 3883 evidence mapped to the adopted US and IEC standards. Because Uganda is landlocked, transit timing through Mombasa or Dar es Salaam means PVoC must be arranged before export, not after arrival.

target.en: Mandatory: UNBS PVoC verification and a Certificate of Conformity for regulated power tools before shipment; adopted US and IEC standards, including IEC 62841, are the technical basis. The Q-Mark applies to locally certified products.
target.zh: 强制：受管制电动工具在出货前须完成 UNBS PVoC 验证并取得符合性证书；采用的美国和 IEC 标准（包括 IEC 62841）为技术基础。Q-Mark 适用于本地认证产品。
target.zht: 強制：受管制電動工具在出貨前須完成 UNBS PVoC 驗證並取得符合性證書；採用的美國和 IEC 標準（包括 IEC 62841）為技術基礎。Q-Mark 適用於本地認證產品。

cn.en: Mandatory China domestic baseline commonly uses the GB/T 3883 series, with CCC where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内强制基线通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列，适用时配合 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內強制基線通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列，適用時配合 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Uganda-ready as-is if the product file only contains GB/T 3883 evidence. A UNBS Certificate of Conformity via PVoC and mapping to the adopted US and IEC standards are required before shipment; GB/T 3883 can support the file but does not by itself clear Uganda market access.

rows.requirement: Noise — No Dedicated Outdoor-Equipment Product Marking
rows.target_requirement: Uganda does not have an EU-style outdoor-equipment noise directive that requires a guaranteed sound-power level and product noise marking before placement, unlike the EU Directive 2000/14/EC. There is therefore no equivalent mandatory product-level noise-marking step for power tools as a market-access condition. Noise is instead addressed through general adopted product standards and, at the workplace level, through the occupational health and safety framework administered under the Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development. Honestly, no source has been verified that imposes a dedicated outdoor-noise product mark in Uganda, so this row is informational and flags an absence rather than a specific marking obligation.
target_standards: No EU-style outdoor-equipment noise product-marking directive identified for Uganda
Occupational health and safety framework administered under the Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development (workplace noise exposure)
Adopted general product standards via UNBS where noise is referenced
rows.china_equivalent: China GB/T 3883 safety evidence usually focuses on electrical and mechanical hazards and may report declared noise values, but it is not a product-marking regime. Because Uganda has no equivalent outdoor-noise product mark, the China and Uganda positions are aligned in that neither imposes an EU-style guaranteed sound-power product label as a market-access gate for these tools.
china_standards: China domestic noise standards where applicable
rows.gap: There is no specific product-marking gap to close for Uganda, because no dedicated outdoor-noise product regime has been verified. The honest action is to not assume an EU 2000/14/EC-style step applies, to keep any declared noise values consistent with the adopted standards, and to manage workplace noise exposure under the occupational health and safety framework. Exporters should still confirm current UNBS references and any updated rules before relying on this absence.

target.en: Not applicable as a dedicated product-marking obligation: no EU-style outdoor-noise product directive identified for Uganda. Workplace noise exposure is governed by the occupational health and safety framework rather than a product mark.
target.zh: 作为专门产品标识义务不适用：未识别到乌干达的欧盟式户外噪声产品指令。工作场所噪声暴露由职业健康安全框架管理，而非产品标识。
target.zht: 作為專門產品標識義務不適用：未識別到烏干達的歐盟式戶外噪聲產品指令。工作場所噪聲暴露由職業健康安全框架管理，而非產品標識。

cn.en: China GB/T 3883 may report noise values but does not impose an outdoor-noise product-marking regime either.
cn.zh: 中国 GB/T 3883 可报告噪声值，但也不设定户外噪声产品标识制度。
cn.zht: 中國 GB/T 3883 可報告噪聲值，但也不設定戶外噪聲產品標識制度。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No dedicated outdoor-noise product-marking step has been verified for Uganda, so no EU 2000/14/EC-style obligation should be assumed; manage declared noise under adopted standards and workplace exposure under the occupational framework, and re-verify current UNBS and labour rules before relying on this absence.

rows.target_requirement: Uganda does not enforce an EU RoHS Directive directly. Restricted-substance and material-safety expectations are met through adopted product and safety standards referenced by UNBS and verified under the PVoC programme, rather than through an EU-format RoHS declaration. Where adopted IEC and product standards reference hazardous-substance limits, the supplier should provide supporting material evidence. Honestly, no Uganda-specific RoHS-equivalent product law has been verified here, so this row flags the route as standards-and-conformity based rather than a standalone substance directive.
target_standards: No EU RoHS-equivalent product directive verified for Uganda
Restricted-substance and material expectations via adopted UNBS product and safety standards
UNBS conformity assessment under the PVoC programme
rows.china_equivalent: China RoHS and GB/T 3883 evidence can support material and safety review. For Uganda, this evidence is mapped to the adopted UNBS standards and verified under PVoC rather than against an EU RoHS declaration; supplier material data should be retained in case a referenced standard sets substance limits.
rows.gap: The gap is documentary rather than a separate Uganda RoHS filing: keep supplier material data and any China RoHS evidence so it can be mapped to whatever substance references the adopted UNBS standards apply, and verify there is no newer Uganda restricted-substance rule before treating this as unregulated.

target.en: Conditional: no standalone Uganda RoHS-equivalent directive verified; restricted-substance expectations flow through adopted UNBS standards and PVoC verification.
target.zh: 有条件：未核验到独立的乌干达 RoHS 对等指令；限用物质要求通过采用的 UNBS 标准和 PVoC 验证传递。
target.zht: 有條件：未核驗到獨立的烏干達 RoHS 對等指令；限用物質要求通過採用的 UNBS 標準和 PVoC 驗證傳遞。

cn.en: China RoHS or GB/T 3883 evidence supports material review but should still be mapped to the adopted UNBS standards for Uganda.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 或 GB/T 3883 证据支持材料审查，但对乌干达仍应映射到采用的 UNBS 标准。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 或 GB/T 3883 證據支援材料審查，但對烏干達仍應映射到採用的 UNBS 標準。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No standalone Uganda RoHS-equivalent obligation has been verified; map China material and RoHS evidence to the adopted UNBS standards under PVoC, retain supplier material data, and re-verify for any newer restricted-substance rule before treating substances as unregulated.

rows.requirement: Cordless Tool Batteries and UCC Radio Approval
rows.target_requirement: Cordless power tools combine a battery pack with the tool, and the battery and charger safety are assessed together under the adopted IEC standards and UNBS PVoC conformity rather than an EU-style standalone battery regulation. Where a cordless tool includes a radio function such as wireless connectivity, the Uganda Communications Commission (UCC) requires type approval of the radio module before the device can be used or sold. Lithium-battery transport and general safety evidence supports shipment, but the controlling Uganda steps are UNBS conformity for safety and UCC type approval for any radio function.
target_standards: Adopted IEC battery and charger safety standards via UNBS
UNBS conformity assessment under the PVoC programme for the cordless tool system
Uganda Communications Commission (UCC) type approval for radio functions in cordless tools
Lithium-battery transport and safety evidence to support shipment
rows.china_equivalent: China tool files often treat the battery pack as an accessory tested with the tool under GB/T 3883, with separate lithium-battery transport and safety evidence. For Uganda, this maps to UNBS conformity under the adopted IEC standards; any radio function additionally needs UCC type approval that China domestic radio approvals do not cover.
china_standards: China lithium battery safety and transport evidence where applicable
China radio type approval (does not substitute for UCC approval)
rows.gap: Two gaps for cordless tools: the battery and charger safety must be mapped to the adopted IEC standards and cleared through UNBS PVoC rather than assumed from the China report, and any radio function must obtain UCC type approval in Uganda, which a China domestic radio approval does not satisfy. There is no verified EU-style standalone battery passport or removability obligation in Uganda, so do not assume one applies, but do confirm current UCC and UNBS rules.

target.en: Mandatory: UNBS conformity through PVoC for the cordless tool and battery system, and UCC type approval for any radio function. No EU-style standalone battery regulation verified for Uganda.
target.zh: 强制：无绳工具及电池系统须通过 PVoC 取得 UNBS 符合性，任何无线电功能须取得 UCC 型号核准。未核验到乌干达存在欧盟式独立电池法规。
target.zht: 強制：無繩工具及電池系統須通過 PVoC 取得 UNBS 符合性，任何無線電功能須取得 UCC 型號核准。未核驗到烏干達存在歐盟式獨立電池法規。

cn.en: China tool and battery evidence and China radio approval do not automatically satisfy UNBS conformity or UCC type approval.
cn.zh: 中国工具和电池证据及中国无线电核准不会自动满足 UNBS 符合性或 UCC 型号核准。
cn.zht: 中國工具和電池證據及中國無線電核准不會自動滿足 UNBS 符合性或 UCC 型號核准。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Uganda-ready for cordless tools until the battery and charger clear UNBS conformity under the adopted IEC standards via PVoC and any radio function obtains UCC type approval; no EU-style standalone battery regulation is assumed, but current UCC and UNBS rules should be re-verified.
